changes.text: New `ariaLabel` prop names the live region (`aria-label` on the root), to tell apart several status/alert regions on one page.
New `no-results` value for `variant`, next to `empty` and `error`.
New `secondaryAction` snippet rendered beside `action`, and a low-emphasis `footer` snippet rendered below everything (`.foot`).

New `visual` snippet for an `Icon`, illustration or image, rendered `aria-hidden`; the string `icon` stays as the fallback and its size now reads `--ss-empty-glyph` (was a hardcoded 40px), so it rescales with the size variant.
New `compact` prop drops the padding and shrinks the title and glyph (`--ss-empty-glyph-compact`) for use inside cards and table cells.

`headingLevel` accepts `false` to render the title as a plain `

` with no heading role.
The root is capped at `--ss-empty-max-w` (360px / 420px / 480px for `sm` / `md` / `lg`) and centered with `margin-inline: auto`; the new `fullWidth` prop removes the cap.
Non-error variants now carry `role="status"` and the root has `aria-atomic="true"`, so the state is announced politely without moving focus; `error` keeps `role="alert"`.
New `size` prop (`sm` | `md` | `lg`), applied as `data-size-variant` on the root; when unset it follows `componentsSize.EmptyState`, then the global `sizeVariant`.
The title has heading semantics (`role="heading"` with `aria-level`), set by the new `headingLevel` prop (default `2`).
The `error` variant is announced with `role="alert"`, and the decorative `icon` glyph is `aria-hidden`.
The root class is `ss-empty` (was `hub-empty`) and the tokens it reads are `--ss-*` (were `--hs-*`).
New component: a centered placeholder for "no data" and "something went wrong" cases, with `variant` (`empty` | `error`), `title`, `message`, an `icon` glyph and an `action` snippet.
